The Verse of the Elder Rādha:
"Just as rain penetrates a poorly-thatched house, so does craving penetrate an unguarded mind."
In this way, lust penetrates a mind that has not been developed,
just as water penetrates a poorly-thatched house.
The rain does not penetrate it;
so too, passion does not penetrate a well-developed mind.”
